method: All nine original PNG files actually produced by this successful production run were opened individually with view_image detail original after Chrome closed. No replacement, montage, DOM edit, zoom or game-clock manipulation was used.

captures.label: me2-withdrawn
captures.source: Actual public viewport, unchanged DOM/style/state and natural ATB time.
captures.notes: ME2 main-period context is visible. Shepard is separated at -7.4 / 0.0 after withdrawal, while both targets remain at their original coordinates.

captures.label: me2-charge-contact
captures.source: Actual public viewport, unchanged DOM/style/state and natural ATB time.
captures.notes: Shepard is now at 2.2 / -2.4 near the 3.8 / -2.8 target. The 1.6 / 12.5 target-range text is visible; no active exposure line remains in this production PNG.

captures.label: me2-exposure-ended
captures.source: Actual public viewport, unchanged DOM/style/state and natural ATB time.
captures.notes: Contact coordinates are retained and the temporary exposure line is absent. This is an end-state screenshot; it is not a positive image of the active three-second risk.

captures.label: me3-withdrawn
captures.source: Actual public viewport, unchanged DOM/style/state and natural ATB time.
captures.notes: ME3 main-period context, workshop targets and the native withdrawal position -7.4 / 0.0 are visible. Coordinates and arena limits are legible.

captures.label: me3-charge-contact
captures.source: Actual public viewport, unchanged DOM/style/state and natural ATB time.
captures.notes: The ME3 marker has moved to 2.2 / -2.4, with a free contact near the target and native range text. The active exposure line has already ended and is not claimed as visible.

captures.label: me3-charge-mobile
captures.source: Actual public viewport, unchanged DOM/style/state and natural ATB time.
captures.notes: At 390 x 844 the numbered arena markers, legend and ATB limitation text remain readable within the panel width. No complete mobile command journey is claimed.

captures.label: me3-exposure-ended
captures.source: Actual public viewport, unchanged DOM/style/state and natural ATB time.
captures.notes: The ME3 contact position remains after the temporary exposure ends; the status line is absent. This image does not establish the damage multiplier by itself.

captures.label: me2-restarted
captures.source: Actual public viewport, unchanged DOM/style/state and natural ATB time.
captures.notes: The reloaded preparation starts a fresh ME2 battle at -3.8 / 0.0, without the prior contact coordinates or exposure; initial target HP and positions are visible.

captures.label: me3-prologue-isolated
captures.source: Actual public viewport, unchanged DOM/style/state and natural ATB time.
captures.notes: The Earth-prologue context and temporary Anderson are visible. Neither the new arena nor Charge appears among the commands.

production.label: ME2-short-exposure-public-limit
production.limitation: État actif non capturé : la fenêtre native de trois secondes avait déjà expiré avant Pause. Aucun PNG positif de cet état n’est revendiqué ; les dégâts réels ×1,15, pause et fin sont couverts par les 91 tests natifs frais.

production.label: ME3-short-exposure-public-limit
production.limitation: État actif non capturé : la fenêtre native de trois secondes avait déjà expiré avant Pause. Aucun PNG positif de cet état n’est revendiqué ; les dégâts réels ×1,15, pause et fin sont couverts par les 91 tests natifs frais.

limitations: État actif non capturé en PNG de production pour ME2 et ME3 : le relevé DOM immédiat voit le statut dans les deux cas, mais la fenêtre naturelle de trois secondes expire avant Pause. Aucun des neuf PNG n’est présenté comme capture positive de cet état actif.

The active +15% states were actually captured and individually reviewed in DEV03. The real 1.15 damage multiplier, pause and expiration are native-test findings; this production run verifies the visible description, displacement, contact and ended status without forcing time.
Desktop screenshots use the declared native 1280 x 1900 viewport. Mobile 390 x 844 evidence is limited to arena layout and horizontal fit.

This is a bounded two-dimensional ATB arena. No original map, obstacle collision solver, physical swept path, sprite movement in a 3D scene, full campaign, original ranks or artistic fidelity is certified. Other powers retain their documented abstract ranges.
